To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the use of text summaries can be a useful approach for the summarization of films and that the use of named entities in a film's cast list can be a useful way to identify the most important shots in a film.
1) the quality of the summaries can be improved by using named entities as keywords, and 2) the quality of a text summary of a film can be evaluated by comparing it against the original text.

(1) the mid-frequency word and named entity based methods for selecting shots from films are complementary; (2) the mid-frequency method produces more informative summaries than the named entity approach; (3) the named entity approach is more effective when the number of shots is limited; (4) the named entity method can produce more coherent summaries; (5) the mid-frequency approach can produce more informative summaries.

the production of text summaries of movies from collateral texts, such as post-production screenplays, audio descriptions, or subtitles.
the automatic construction of text and video summaries of films.
the production of text and time-based summaries of film stories.
